keyAndScale.modalCharacter: F Aeolian / Minor Pentatonic with driving chromatic power chord roots

scalesUsed.name: F Minor Pentatonic
scalesUsed.application: The tonal backbone for both the 4-chord rhythm progression and the vocal-mirroring solo

scalesUsed.name: F Natural Minor (Aeolian)
scalesUsed.notes: F - G - Ab - Bb - C - Db - Eb
scalesUsed.application: Provides the dark, rebellious grunge harmonic foundation

mainProgression.description: The definitive 4-chord grunge riff alternating between 1st-fret and 4th-fret root positions with percussive muted strums

sectionProgressions.description: Full-throated distortion explosion using two measures of alternating syncopated power chords
Sparse, hypnotic clean guitar motif playing unisons and 4ths with watery chorus pedal modulation
Kurt Cobain restates the vocal melody directly on the G and B strings with expressive full-step bends

harmonicFunction: F5 (i5) - The heavy tonic anchor played on fret 1 of the low E string
Bb5 (iv5) - Directly below on fret 1 of the A string, creating immediate downward weight
Ab5 (III5) - Shifts up 3 frets to the minor third, offering a fleeting lift of relative major brightness
Db5 (VI5) - Submediant resolution providing the punchy rhythmic climax before the turnaround

techniques.name: Percussive 16th-Note Dead Rakes (Scratch Strumming)
techniques.description: Lightly resting the fretting fingers flat across all strings to mute them while executing rapid alternate 16th-note down-up strums

notes: Fret hand lifts pressure just enough to deaden all strings
Pick hand executes rapid down-up-down-up scratch rhythms
Creates the famous rhythmic 'chicka-chicka' engine of the riff
Must stay perfectly locked in the 117 BPM groove
sequence: Lift fretting fingers and rake four 16th-note scratches
Shift to Bb5 and strike twice
Repeat pattern moving to Ab5 and Db5
tips: Keep the strumming wrist completely loose like shaking water off your hand
Ensure zero harmonic overtones ring out during the scratches by using multiple resting fingers
details.progression: F5 - [Muted Rakes] - Bb5 - Ab5 - [Muted Rakes] - Db5

techniques.name: Loud-Quiet-Loud Dynamic Contrast
techniques.description: The trademark Pixies/Nirvana structural technique of dropping from raging fuzz to whisper-quiet clean guitar and back

notes: Switch distortion pedal (Boss DS-1 or DS-2) on for choruses, completely off for verses
Light picking touch on the two-note verse motif
Explosive downstroke attack when the full band slams into the chorus
sequence: Clean verse: 2-note motif over bass and drums
Chorus: Full gain stomp with all power chords
tips: Match your physical energy to the dynamic level
Let the chorus pedal wash over the verse notes without overplaying
details.progression: F - C motif into full F5

techniques.name: Vocal-Mirroring Lead Phrasing
techniques.description: Cobain's signature soloing approach: rather than shredding scales, he directly replicates the verse vocal melody on guitar with raw attitude

notes: Played primarily across frets 5-10 on the G and B strings
Uses aggressive whole-step bends and wide unpolished vibrato
Ends with high-register feedback squeals
sequence: Trace vocal line on G string (frets 6, 8, 10)
Add full bend on fret 8 resolving to 6
Hold sustained notes into amplifier feedback
tips: Sing the lyrics in your head while playing the solo notes
Focus on pitch accuracy on the string bends

sections.name: Intro Teaser & Distorted Crash
sections.description: Kurt's iconic clean four-bar teaser followed by Dave Grohl's explosive drum fill and the full-band distorted crash with 16th-note percussive scratch rakes.
notes: F5 is at fret 1 (low E), Bb5 is at fret 1 (A string)
Ab5 is at fret 4 (low E), Db5 is at fret 4 (A string)
Insert 4 sixteen-note muted scratches between chord changes

sections.name: Verse 1 Clean Minimalism & Small Clone Chorus
sections.description: The sparse clean guitar figure playing high F and C unisons drenched in analog chorus while Krist Novoselic's bass carries the main groove ('Load up on guns, bring your friends...').
notes: Clean tone with Small Clone chorus pedal engaged
Fret 1 on B string (C) and fret 1 on high E string (F)
Let both notes ring together into the empty space

sections.name: Pre-Chorus Tension ('Hello, Hello, How Low')
sections.description: The mounting vocal tension over sustained guitar notes and rising drum energy building toward the chorus explosion.
notes: Position foot over the Boss DS-1 or DS-2 distortion switch
Let the strings ring with growing pick intensity
Stomp on beat 1 precisely as the snare cracks

sections.name: Chorus Distortion Explosion ('With the Lights Out')
sections.description: The full-force grunge eruption on F5 - Bb5 - Ab5 - Db5 with Dave Grohl's crash cymbals and Kurt's roaring vocals.
notes: Full downstrokes on every chord strike
Keep the 16th-note scratch rakes tight and percussive
Lock into the 117 BPM groove without speeding up

sections.name: Kurt Cobain Vocal-Mirroring Guitar Solo
sections.description: Cobain directly quotes his vocal melody with heavy distortion and biting pick attack, ending in wild bends and screeching feedback.
notes: Matches the melody of 'with the lights out, it's less dangerous'
Use aggressive pick attack and let the distortion bloom
Bend the 8th fret on the G string with your ring finger backed by middle and index

sections.name: Outro Distortion Fury & Screaming Climax ('A Denial!')
sections.description: Relentless repeat of the chorus riff beneath Kurt's throat-shredding screams, ending in howling feedback against the amplifier speaker cone.
notes: Maximum right-hand aggression through the final repetitions
Lean guitar body toward the amp speaker for controlled feedback squeals
Final authoritative downstroke choke on F5

guitar.recommended: Fender Mustang, Jaguar, or Stratocaster with bridge humbucker
guitar.pickup: Bridge humbucker for cutting distortion attack

amp.recommended: Mesa/Boogie Studio .22 Preamp into Crown Power Amp / Fender Twin Reverb

effects.distortion: Boss DS-1 or DS-2 Turbo Distortion (Level: 10, Tone: 6, Distortion: 10)
effects.other: Electro-Harmonix Small Clone analog chorus pedal for the verse

beginner.title: Master the 4 Power Chords & Scratch Strumming
steps: Learn two-finger and three-finger power chord shapes for F5, Bb5, Ab5, and Db5
Practice shifting cleanly between 1st fret and 4th fret on the E and A strings
Develop the relaxed wrist movement for the 16th-note scratch rakes

intermediate.title: Full Song Timing, Dynamic Stompbox Transitions & Verse Tone
steps: Lock the chorus riff tightly to a metronome at 117 BPM
Coordinate kicking the distortion pedal on beat 1 of the chorus
Learn the clean verse motif and Small Clone chorus settings

advanced.title: Guitar Solo Phrasing & Live Attitude
steps: Play the vocal-mirroring solo with accurate intonation on the bends
Master controlling musical amplifier feedback on the final held notes
Perform the entire 5-minute track with genuine grunge energy and dynamic contrast

commonMistakes: Pressing down too hard during muted scratch strums, creating unwanted notes or harmonics
Rushing the tempo during the chorus explosion—keep the groove seated at 117 BPM
Overcomplicating the solo instead of honoring the vocal melody phrasing
practiceRoutine: 5 min: Warm up fretting-hand muting and 16th-note alternate strumming
10 min: Practice the F5 to Bb5 and Ab5 to Db5 chord shifts at 90 BPM
10 min: Practice kicking distortion on and off for dynamic transitions
10 min: Work on the solo phrasing and bend pitch accuracy
focusAreas: Left-hand muting technique for crisp, noise-free dead scratches
Dynamic pedal stomp transitions from clean to fuzz
Rhythmic pocket and consistency at 117 BPM
metronomeWork: Practice the main riff at 90 BPM with eighth-note clicks, building to 117 BPM
Isolate the scratch strum measure at 100 BPM until effortless
